music.title: The Understanding Key / Original Instrumental Battle Chiptune

theme.key: E minor; parallel E major from 51.2s

narrative.name: 知识之塔
narrative.intent: Immediate timpani + brass fanfare; introduce the hook, open the tower

narrative.name: 熟悉的幻觉
narrative.intent: Busy sixteenth arpeggios / confident pulse answers: memorization overload

narrative.name: 解释失败
narrative.intent: Exact 12.8s tape/bit stop, short digital void, then low suspense ostinato

narrative.name: 选一个概念
narrative.intent: Huge heroic reset: first four bars of the eight-bar main theme

narrative.name: 讲给新手
narrative.intent: Theme bars five to eight; lower call / two-octave upper answer

narrative.name: 补上缺口
narrative.intent: Increasing density, dominant pedal and rising inversions; BPM stays 150

narrative.name: 化繁为简
narrative.intent: Largest minor-key drop, octave lead doubling, double-time snare feel

narrative.name: 再讲一遍
narrative.intent: Four-step retry staircase; quarter/eighth/sixteenth/32nd snare build

narrative.name: 真正的理解
narrative.intent: Parallel E-major victory; restate hook, tonic cadence, final 0.4s fade

music.synthesis: Deterministic original Node oscillators, filtered seeded noise, additive triangle, polyBLEP pulse/saw; Float64 oscillator/filter math and Float32 stereo buses. No samples, third-party tunes, TTS, or network.

processing.signalChain: Float32 mix -> 25Hz highpass / 17kHz lowpass -> gentle 1.65:1 glue -> R128-measured fixed gain -> stereo-linked 192kHz lookahead limiter (latency compensated) -> 48kHz 24-bit PCM -> 256kbps gapless MP3
processing.stereo: 1.9x side gain on tonal bus / 1.6x room width; unchanged mid and centered low end; no master phase delay
processing.drumSidechain: 32% depth / 45ms decay on tonal bus only; no narration ducking

provenance.music: Original locally composed and synthesized music, no samples or existing recordings.

delivery.playback: Native HTMLAudioElement, local relative audio/master.mp3; no WebAudio/fetch required.

timing.method: Full-scan leading-edge detector on actual pre-mix mono kick/timpani/stop bus (>96 silent samples, |x|>1e-10), one-to-one against scheduled beats; decoded-master 80ms RMS at each detected event.
timing.errorInterpretation: Envelopes start at exactly beat sample with zero amplitude; first nonzero normally follows by one sample.
